message:
Fixed. "Crème brûlée recipes" now becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

The change is one line in `src/blog/slug.js`. Before slugifying, the title is decomposed (NFD) and the combining accent marks are stripped, so "è" becomes "e" instead of being dropped. I didn't touch the vendored slugger, since `vendor/README.md` says it's upgraded by replacing the folder, not by hand.

Two things you may want to know:
- **Product URLs have the same bug.** `src/shop/product-url.js` also uses the vendored slugger, so product names with accents will still lose letters. I left it alone because you scoped this to blog posts. Applying the same normalization there is a one-line change if you want it.
- **No commit.** The change is uncommitted in the working tree.
